summary_1line: Bhishma recounts Brahma’s revelation that the supreme Vasudeva will incarnate among humans to destroy Asuras and support the Pandavas, affirming Krishna’s divine supremacy.

image_candidates.scene_text: Brahma humbly addresses the radiant Lord Vasudeva as the deity appears briefly before the gathered gods and sages.
The assembled gods, rishis, and gandharvas gaze in wonder as the mysterious deity vanishes after promising to incarnate among humans.
Bhishma, lying on his bed of arrows, declares before a king that where Krishna stands there dwell righteousness and inevitable victory.
